rating_actions_in_window.action: Assign A- to CHFFA 2024 Series A & B issue ($105.5M); first ever RCFE-only CCRC bond under AB 839
Affirm A- Stable (cites outpacing projections, 100% pre-sale on 40 new ILUs)

verified_outcome.notes: Fitch noted ECS outpacing projections; 40/40 new ILUs (Canterbury 2.0 expansion) had deposits placed by Dec 2024 although fill-up not until 2026.

ccrc_occupancy.notes: Fitch Dec 2024 confirms strong demand: 100% of 40 new Canterbury ILUs pre-sold via deposits before 2026 occupancy. MonteCedro reached ~78% occupancy by year 1 (2016), now mature. No SNF beds on any campus (RCFE-only).
ccrc_occupancy._warning: Specific IL/AL percentages not extractable from Fitch PDF; demand indicators strong

ccrc_days_cash.notes: June 2024 audit available but not text-extracted. A- rating implies DCOH likely 300-500 days. CHFFA 2024 issue would have included reserves and bonds proceeds.

ma_events_2023_2025.event: $105.5M CHFFA tax-exempt issue (Series 2024A entrance fees + 2024B); first RCFE-only CCRC bond under AB 839 expansion (chaptered Oct 2023)
Canterbury 2.0 expansion (40 new ILUs); 100% pre-sale by Dec 2024
